name: Canterbury Earthquake Recovery Authority (CERA)
story: CERA’s spatial-data infrastructure supported a recovery programme involving many agencies and rapidly changing information. Stephen Ferriss and Martin Erasmuson’s March 2016 whitepaper records its governance and cloud architecture. Public lookup services and secure information-sharing addressed different needs, while the organisation also had to plan how its systems and records would continue after CERA closed.

sources.label: Ferriss, S. and Erasmuson, M., The Canterbury Earthquake Recovery Authority Spatial Data Infrastructure
